english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 22of Schedule 4 to the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2002provides that it shall be a defence for a person charged under theseRegulations to show that he took all reasonable steps to avoid the commissionof the offence.
(ii) Regulation 11(7) of chapter V of theInternational Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea provides that "a shipshall use a mandatory ships' routeing system adopted by the Organization asrequired for its category or cargo carried and in accordance with the relevantprovisions in force unless there are compelling reasons not to use a particularships' routeing system. Any such reason shall be recorded in the ships' log".

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
